response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), s AS (SELECT gender, order_count, order_count * 1.0 / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM g), a AS (SELECT gender, order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT gender, order_count, share, share - avg_share AS share_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share
